probe_target.question: what makes this transition jump — the colour of the cell below, or the Cart's being on this particular cell?  Both fit the single witness; M8 designs an experiment that separates them.

located.reading: at t=11 the Cart is at (6, 4), the action is DOWN, the manual fires nothing and predicts the Cart stays at (6, 4), and the world puts it at (7, 6) — a jump of 3 cells.  No rule in this manual has an effect that moves the mover more than one cell, so the defect is a MISSING RULE, not a wrong one: nothing here can be corrected, something has to be added.
